audience: delivery and field service teams that plan routes and drivers in Locate2u

useCases.title: Plan tomorrow: stops and missing drivers
useCases.text: List the stops that are scheduled for a day. List the stops and shipments that no driver has yet.

useCases.title: Review the trips of every driver for a day
useCases.text: Get a summary of all trips of the team with driver, distance, time and stop counts. Open one trip to read its stops.

useCases.title: Find an order by its reference
useCases.text: Find an order by order number or purchase order number. Read the order, and the stop that belongs to it.

useCases.title: Check proof of delivery and customer ratings
useCases.text: Read the answers that a driver gave on a stop. List the delivery ratings that customers left over a date range.

useCases.title: Report the distance driven by the team
useCases.text: Read the distance and the time that each team member drove over a date range.

useCases.title: Leave a note for the driver on a stop
useCases.text: Add a text note to a stop or to a shipment. The team and the driver can read it.
